ACT IV OF 2020
ACT IV OF 2020
COASTAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2019
An Act to amend the Coastal Development
Authority Act, 1994
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV,
30th January, 2020]
NO.
PAS/LEGIS-B-22/2019, dated 30.1.2020.---The Coastal Development Authority (Amendment) Bill, 2019 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 18th December, 2019 and assented
to by the Governor of Sindh on 22nd January, 2020 is hereby published as an Act
of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Coastal
Development Authority Act, 1994, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is
hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Coastal Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2019.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.

Amendment of Long title and Preamble of Sindh Act No. XXVIII of 1994

PAS/LEGIS-B-22/2019, dated 30.1.2020.---The Coastal Development Authority (Amendment) Bill, 2019 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 18th December, 2019 and assented
to by the Governor of Sindh on 22nd January, 2020 is hereby published as an Act
of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Coastal
Development Authority Act, 1994, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is
hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment
of Long title and Preamble of Sindh Act No. XXVIII of 1994.---In the Coastal Development Authority Act, 1994,
hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in the long title and Preamble for the
words "coastal areas of the Districts Thatta and Badin", the words
"coastal areas of Province of Sindh" shall be substituted.

3. Amendment
of section 2 of Sindh Act No. XXVIII of 1994.---In the said Act, in section 2, for clause (c), the following shall be
substituted:-
"(c)
"coastal areas" means the coastal areas of the Province of
Sindh;".
